pair_decision.evidence: At index 626, N/E/U all show a sustained elevated platform (N ~−2.5→−1.5 mm, E ~4→7 mm, U ~−10→−8 mm) that persists until ~660–665, then returns toward the pre-626 trend; the return is not abrupt but gradual and aligns with continuing local trajectory, especially visible in E and U residuals. The later step at 661/666 is part of the same recovery, not an independent jump. R1 and R2 overlap; only one can be selected. R3 extends too far (to 691) where the signal has already resumed trend without clear platform end. R1 best matches observed platform start (626) and return onset (~660), supported across all components.
